description: "The Lives of the Fathers, Martyrs, and Other Principal Saints" by Alban Butler is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work serves as a collection of biographies and accounts of various saints, emphasizing their lives, virtues, and the history of the Christian faith throughout different eras and cultures.
